# semaphore_ex_global_workflow_artifact_retention_publish (Action)

Publishes an append-only, revision-fenced Semaphore EX workflow artifact retention policy. Invoke explicitly; the API deliberately has no delete or reset operation.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expected_revision` (Number) Exact current revision; use 0 only before the first publication.
- `max_artifact_bytes` (Number)
- `max_run_bytes` (Number)
- `retention_seconds` (Number)

### Optional

- `project_id` (Number)
